token_authentication_mechanism.token_origin: Generated dynamically from username/password via pyTigerGraph authentication / token request
token_authentication_mechanism.storage_location: In-memory on TigerGraphConnection object (conn.apiToken) and passed in REST HTTP headers (Authorization: Bearer <token>)

initialization_path_forensics.unauthenticated_response: HTTP 403 REST-10016 (Access Denied because the input token = '' is empty or too short)

failure_classification.root_cause_explanation: TigerGraph Cloud instance was in a suspended/waking state. Nginx gateway returned 502 / 'Starting workspace' HTML during instance resume. Not an application auth token code failure.

next_manual_powershell_diagnostic: docker exec graphrag python -c "from common.config import db_config; from pyTigerGraph import TigerGraphConnection; conn = TigerGraphConnection(host=db_config['hostname'], username=db_config['username'], password=db_config['password'], graphname=db_config['graphname'], restppPort=db_config['restppPort'], gsPort=db_config['gsPort']); print('TG Version:', conn.getVer())"
